name: MCP Tool Call
description: Runs a remote MCP tool via HTTP(s)

server.description: HTTP(S) base URL or explicit /mcp endpoint for the MCP server; trailing slashes are accepted

token.description: API access token to use for the delegated MCP request

arguments.description: Arguments to the MCP tool call

output.description: The MCP tool output. Typically the content array or a structuredContent Object
